scope: One necessary-condition decision: eye-position error cannot be copied 1:1 into an optical exit aperture guard.

ownership.registryDistinction: MINI02 (without hyphen) is M2 mechanical evaluation; do not infer its owner from the optical study label.

selectedDecision.reason: The existing 30mm guard is explicitly a sensitivity example (10mm frame + hypothetical 20mm erosion), not a certified 20mm tracking tolerance. A same-face ray counterexample requires ten times that erosion. This closes a missing mapping argument, not a bug claim against the existing solver.
selectedDecision.sourceGap: candidate-assessment: actual tracking/placement error to aperture erosion mapping undefined; finite-cone: total angle error synthetic, positional conversion unimplemented.
selectedDecision.engineeringAction: Do not release an optical aperture, tracker accuracy requirement or final driver/PCB using eyeErrorM == extraGuardM. Bind a measured error envelope to each eye/target/exit geometry; reject missing paths and leave unmeasured envelopes UNKNOWN.

model.derivation: For fixed target T, eye E, and intersected plane normal n at B: P_t = T_t + s*(T_t-E_t), s=(B-T_n)/(T_n-E_n). If E_n,T and the intersected face stay fixed, delta(P_t)=-s*delta(E_t).
model.validity: Homogeneous straight-ray geometry only; fixed target and normal coordinates; all tested perturbed rays must retain the same face. No optical diffraction/relay/physical light claim.
model.unknownGeneralCase: normal-axis, target, aperture pose, lens mapping, timing/motion and covariance errors need a larger measured envelope; this one-axis bound is not their total.
model.sampling: counterexamples are additional diagnostics within the same domain, not replacements for the original 35721 pairs / 18 rays

counterexample.units: metres; eye is one pupil sample, not a new eye-center/IPD model
counterexample.inputMeaning: Comparison hypothesis only. No sensor is claimed to have measured 20mm error.

candidatePolicy.fixedWithMissingPairs: REJECT_AS_ALL_RANGE_SOLUTION in the declared optimistic model; optical steering/brightness alone cannot supply missing exit positions.
candidatePolicy.sixFullFacesIdeal: NOT_ADOPTED: 80 square metres of ideal emitting boundary, no physical engine, no compact/few-parts/comfort proof; passing finite geometry is a control only.
candidatePolicy.relocatableOrSwitched: UNPROVEN: existing finite-cone/joint source remains reusable host implementation, but measured exit/calibration/error/trajectory/throughput/comfort/stop are UNKNOWN. Do not regress that implementation to absent.
candidatePolicy.existingGoRelay: UNPROVEN: no qualified room-boundary ray generator, per-ray error envelope, vertical cone or low-glare/independent optical cutoff acceptance.
candidatePolicy.particleResearch: OUTSIDE_THIS_RAY_MODEL: retain prior hardware-feasibility research; no adoption or impossibility conclusion from this counterexample.
candidatePolicy.plateE0: NOT_ADOPTED_AS_FINAL_REQUIREMENT: no permission to put plate/membrane at image position.

bench.purpose: Measure the geometry/tracking error envelope needed before choosing aperture margin. No display light source is required for this step.
setup: M4 freezes measured aperture rectangles, physical frames, world transforms and pose revisions; the 1200mm virtual plane here is a metrology reference, not a selected device.

M3 uses an existing approved position reference/fixture and an inert pupil surrogate at the specified E, with a fixed world target coordinate T. Align the existing tracker and independent reference to one world frame. No new purchase, model run or power-on is authorized by this package.

Record raw reference and reported 3D position with acquisition timestamps and uncertainty. Include the upward and downward cases, the near-edge counterexample, the original both-pupil offsets, remounts, above/below occlusion and loss/recovery.

Offline replay each measured position through the pinned geometry source. Measure target/aperture calibration uncertainty separately. Retain failed and missing samples; do not drop them to improve the result.

acceptance.counterexampleOneAxisOnly: For this exact geometry with other errors fixed to zero: gain=10, nearest physical-edge clearance=30mm, hence the strictly-inside threshold is |eye_x_error| + reference_bound < 3mm. Equality is BOUNDARY_UNKNOWN, not pass. This is a derived metrology target, not a measured sensor rating or whole-product threshold.
acceptance.generalGate: For every required ray, the complete propagated uncertainty footprint must be strictly inside at least one qualified aperture and finite cone. Unknown/error-correlation or face-changing intervals without a conservative enclosure => UNKNOWN. Any actual missing ray => FAIL. All uncertainty budgets and geometry must be revision-bound.
acceptance.noFalsePass: Finite samples below threshold yield only SAMPLE_ENVELOPE_INSIDE; they do not prove a worst-case sensor bound, continuous full domain, simultaneous light, visibility or low glare.
acceptance.repeatPlan: One stationary log and one controlled motion/loss/recovery log per pose, minimum 1000 timestamped valid/invalid events each as a proposed diagnostic acquisition floor, not statistical confidence. Report duration and every dropout. Additional acquisition/coverage is set by M7 from observed rates and uncertainty, not a completion percentage.

stopConditions: Missing reference uncertainty, invalid frame or stale/missing timestamps => stop acceptance and record UNKNOWN.
Tracker loss, uncalibrated/remounted aperture, face change not enclosed, or any ray outside => record failure; do not enable output.
Any request to add optical output or energize new hardware is outside this offline package; the existing optical/safety/approval gates remain closed.

deliverable.summary: One revision-bound error-envelope report per geometry, with true/reported pupil and target positions, aperture/pose hashes, error bounds and their confidence/assumptions, per-ray margins, UNKNOWN/FAIL reasons, and instrument/reference uncertainty.
deliverable.rawTraceStorage: Git-external trace, digest and bounded worst-case/failed-row witnesses in report; no private camera images.
deliverable.decisionConsumer: M4 aperture/pose choice and M3 tracker specification, reviewed by M7; M1 keeps MAT15 physical gates unresolved.

limitations: No new vendor facts, hardware operation, model execution, purchase, network service, paid execution or public release.
Only three files in the assigned temporary directory are written. Existing canonical docs, IDs, hashes and other work are untouched.
No time estimate without observation; no product completion percentage.
